meta.notes: Pins the DST fall-back cooling regression (dryer_monitor.py:1386-1397; ported by test_appliance_cooling_dst.py's DryerCoolingCheckCrossesTheFallBackBoundary). Real Europe/Copenhagen 2026-10-25 fall-back: 00:55:00Z = 02:55 CEST (anchor, t=0) to 01:07:00Z = 02:07 CET (t=720) - a naive LOCAL-time implementation sees local clock run backward 48 minutes there, making `now - last_state_change` negative, which is trivially < cooling_period and would wrongly refuse the transition. The engine's Clock is UTC-aware only (spec 3.1, 3.3) so this is structurally impossible: boots straight into Running with state_since=anchor, then a DOOR_OPENED-while-high-power at t=720 (RESPECT-gated per 3.3, real elapsed 720s > cooling_period=600s) must be ALLOWED, landing Paused.
